subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw establish opt-in paired-node native Claude CLI execution and its streaming protocol as a supported core security and compatibility boundary?
rationale: The PR adds remote process execution, protocol, configuration, and plugin/API contracts whose permanent ownership and trust model require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after boundary review
options.body: Accept the architecture after focused security, compatibility, protocol, and live end-to-end proof confirm the proposed enforcement points.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Keep catalog rows view-only until a smaller generic node-agent execution contract and its ownership model are approved separately.

options.title: Reject the core direction
options.body: Close the PR and tracking issue if native agent turns on paired nodes should not become a core capability.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary review
recommendation.body: Accept the architecture after focused security, compatibility, protocol, and live end-to-end proof confirm the proposed enforcement points.
